title: strainshare: a standardized, contamination-aware framework for gut-cervicovaginal bacterial strain sharing
description: A versioned, reference-based standard for strain-sharing analysis between the gut and the female genital tract. Packages a population-aware shared-strain call, a within-vs-between-person null, a translocation-vs-contamination discriminator, a generalist-strain filter, longitudinal-only transmission-direction inference, and a low-biomass StrainGE fallback. Includes real-read benchmarks establishing a ~10x confidence floor and a species-agnostic ~0.1% divergence resolution limit, and a validation on a public pregnancy cohort (PRJNA288562).
